record.question: What is the advantage of Patient Package Inserts?
options: They contain pharmacology details meant to help prescribers.
They are used only in low-income countries to reduce man power.
They provide information that improves patient understanding.
They replace the need for pharmacist counselling.
record.explanation: Answer C: They provide information that improves patient understanding.. Patient package inserts provide medicine-use information intended to help patients understand safe use, risks, and instructions. Reference: https://www.fda.gov/drugs/ensuring-safe-use-medicine/medication-guides. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
